column _system.session_state.expires_at timestamp with time zone not null
column _system.session_state.key text not null
column _system.session_state.session_id uuid not null
column _system.session_state.thread_id text not null
column _system.session_state.updated_at timestamp with time zone not null default now()
column _system.session_state.value jsonb not null
index CREATE INDEX idx_session_state_expiry ON _system.session_state USING btree (expires_at)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX session_state_pkey ON _system.session_state USING btree (session_id, thread_id, key)
row level security _system.session_state off
